title: Custodial Fees Comparison
takeaway: Silver IRA custodian fees are typically lower than the costs associated with storing physical silver.

data.label: Silver IRA Custodial Fees
data.value: Approximately 1% of total IRA assets annually
data.evidence: As of 2024, average annual custodian fees are approximately 1% of the total IRA assets. This means that if you have a $10,000 IRA, you’ll pay $100 per year in fees.

data.label: Physical Silver Storage Costs
data.evidence: Storing physical silver at home presents significant security risks. You’re responsible for protecting it from theft, damage, and environmental factors like humidity and corrosion. A dedicated home safe is an investment in itself, and even the best safes aren’t foolproof.

narration: Silver IRAs offer a lower ongoing cost compared to physical silver storage. Custodial fees are typically around 1% of the IRA assets, while home safe costs can range from $500 to $5,000 or more.
